text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-controlled Herald newspaper on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe will receive a Z$585 million grant from the Norwegian government over the next three years to support the southern African country's family health projects, the key agricultural sector, democracy and human rights programmes, a senior Zimbabwe government official told the Herald on Thursday.

- A high court judge has ordered Zimbabwe's Africa University to reinstate 270 students who had been dismissed for leading class boycotts in protest against a 17 percent increase in school fees. The judge ruled university authorities had not followed proper disciplinary procedures in suspending the students.
- Zimbabwe celebrates its 17th independence anniversary today, Friday.
